profileBanner.title: Set up your profile
profileBanner.body: Choose a handle and add a picture, so guests can find and follow you.

home.title: Home
home.welcomeLead: Let's get your first event live. It takes a few minutes.
home.noPaid: No paid sales in this period

checklist.title: Get set up
checklist.createdEventHint: Add the basics, the date and place, and your tickets.
checklist.sharedEventHint: Send the link. It shows your flyer, the date and the price.
checklist.payoutReady: Set up payouts to sell tickets
checklist.payoutReadyHint: Apply for paid tickets and add the bank account sales are paid into.

payout.title: Payouts
payout.activeHint: Paystack pays each sale into your bank account. G-ventZ never holds your money.

status.country_off: Not available in your country yet

hint.not_applied: Apply to sell paid tickets. Free events need nothing more.
hint.application_submitted: We usually reply within two working days.
hint.application_declined: See the reason on the Payouts page.
hint.approval_revoked: See the Payouts page for what happened.
hint.payout_account_pending: Paystack is confirming your bank account.
hint.payments_off: Paid tickets are paused for everyone at the moment.
hint.country_off: You can still host free events.
hint.owes_money: Refunds or disputes left a balance; it is taken from your next sales.
hint.suspended: Contact support to find out more.

appearance.title: Dashboard style
appearance.hint: The colours of your host area. Only you see it; your event pages keep their own style.

language.title: Language
language.hint: The language of G-ventZ and the emails we send you.

scan.title: Scan tickets
scan.lead: Choose the event you're checking guests in for.
scan.noneHint: Published events you can check guests in for show here until they end.

orders.title: Orders & guests
orders.lead: Every order across your events. Open one to see its guests.
orders.caption: {total, plural, one {# order} other {# orders}}
orders.noneHint: Orders show here as soon as someone registers or buys a ticket.

payouts.title: Settlements by event
payouts.caption: Sales, fees and what's left for you, per event
payouts.failed: Settlements couldn't be loaded. Please try again.
payouts.noneHint: Once you sell paid tickets, each event's sales and fees show here.
